clips.title: The story
paras: Bluefen is a soggy marshland nestled in northern Dustwallow Marsh just east of Brackenwall Village. Crawling with aggressive wetland predators, the mire has also become a staging ground for covert Theramore Infiltrators keeping watch on local Horde movements.

Situated just east of the Stonemaul ogres of Brackenwall Village, Bluefen embodies the untamed hazards of Dustwallow Marsh. The humid swampland teems with predatory beasts, including raptors, giant spiders, carrion-feeding birds, and lurking crocolisks. Beyond natural predators, travelers must contend with Theramore Infiltrators who skulk through the murky terrain to spy on the Horde and project human influence deeper into the swamp.
